"""Official MultiRocket features with TRAIN-only residual OAS geometry."""
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler
from experiments.exp449_residual_fn_method_qualification_antigravity.representations_antigravity import make_representation_antigravity
from experiments.exp449_residual_fn_method_qualification_antigravity.local_gap_antigravity import LocalGapModelAntigravity
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.geometry_heads_antigravity import matrix,OASGeometry
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import SEED

class MultiRocketHeads:
    names=('MiniRocket','oas_distance','multirocket_distance','multirocket_joint')
    def __init__(self,rows):
        x=matrix(rows)
        if len(x)<2:raise ValueError('at least two TRAIN rows required')
        self.length=int(x.shape[1])
        self.raw_encoder=make_representation_antigravity('minirocket_local_gap',SEED)
        self.multi_encoder=make_representation_antigravity('multirocket_local_gap',SEED)
        raw=self.raw_encoder.fit_transform(x);multi=self.multi_encoder.fit_transform(x)
        self.diagnostics=dict(raw_featuredim=int(raw.shape[1]),multi_featuredim=int(multi.shape[1]),multi_zero_iqr_fraction=float(np.mean(np.diff(np.quantile(multi,[.1,.9],axis=0),axis=0)[0]<=1e-12)))
        self.control=LocalGapModelAntigravity(raw);self.models={}
        for name,features in zip(self.names[1:],(raw,multi,np.column_stack((raw,multi)))):
            scaler=self.control.scaler if name=='oas_distance' else RobustScaler(quantile_range=(10,90)).fit(features)
            scaled=scaler.transform(features);geometry=OASGeometry(scaled)
            self.models[name]=(scaler,geometry,geometry.transform(scaled))

    def score(self,rows):
        x=matrix(rows)
        if x.shape[1]!=self.length:raise ValueError('query length differs')
        raw=self.raw_encoder.transform(x);multi=self.multi_encoder.transform(x)
        result=dict(MiniRocket=self.control.score(raw))
        for name,features in zip(self.names[1:],(raw,multi,np.column_stack((raw,multi)))):
            scaler,geometry,reference=self.models[name];d=cdist(geometry.transform(scaler.transform(features)),reference)
            result[name]=np.sort(d,axis=1)[:,:min(3,len(reference))].mean(axis=1)
        if not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in result.values()):raise ValueError('nonfinite multirocket score')
        return result

"""Official MultiRocket features, scaler/geometry equality, baseline OAS, isolation, short L, rejects."""
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import configure_inner_threads_antigravity
configure_inner_threads_antigravity()
import numpy as np
import pytest
from aeon.transformations.collection.convolution_based import MiniRocket, MultiRocket
from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler
from experiments.exp505_multirocket_geometry_antigravity.multirocket_antigravity import MultiRocketHeads,SEED
from experiments.exp449_residual_fn_method_qualification_antigravity.representations_antigravity import make_representation_antigravity
from experiments.exp449_residual_fn_method_qualification_antigravity.local_gap_antigravity import LocalGapModelAntigravity
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.geometry_heads_antigravity import PairedHeads,OASGeometry

def test_official_features_scaler_geometry_and_joint_dim():
    assert SEED==20260721
    assert MultiRocketHeads.names==('MiniRocket','oas_distance','multirocket_distance','multirocket_joint')
    rng=np.random.default_rng(505)
    x=rng.normal(size=(6,128))
    collection=np.asarray(x,dtype=np.float32)[:,np.newaxis,:]
    expected_raw=np.asarray(MiniRocket(n_kernels=4096,n_jobs=1,random_state=SEED).fit_transform(collection),dtype=float)
    expected_multi=np.asarray(MultiRocket(n_kernels=1024,max_dilations_per_kernel=32,n_features_per_kernel=4,normalise=False,n_jobs=1,random_state=SEED).fit_transform(collection),dtype=float)
    assert expected_raw.shape==(6,4032)
    head=MultiRocketHeads(x)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.raw_encoder.transform(x),expected_raw,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.multi_encoder.transform(x),expected_multi,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(make_representation_antigravity('minirocket_local_gap',SEED).fit_transform(x),expected_raw,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(make_representation_antigravity('multirocket_local_gap',SEED).fit_transform(x),expected_multi,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    assert head.length==128
    assert set(head.diagnostics)=={'raw_featuredim','multi_featuredim','multi_zero_iqr_fraction'}
    assert head.diagnostics['raw_featuredim']==4032
    assert head.diagnostics['multi_featuredim']==int(expected_multi.shape[1])
    assert 0<=head.diagnostics['multi_zero_iqr_fraction']<=1
    assert head.models['multirocket_joint'][2].shape==(6,4032+int(expected_multi.shape[1]))
    assert head.models['oas_distance'][0] is head.control.scaler
    control=LocalGapModelAntigravity(expected_raw)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.control.scaler.center_,control.scaler.center_,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.control.scaler.scale_,control.scaler.scale_,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    z=control.scaler.transform(expected_raw)
    oas=OASGeometry(z);geo=head.models['oas_distance'][1]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(geo.center,oas.center,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(geo.basis,oas.basis,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(geo.factor,oas.factor,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose([geo.shrinkage,geo.tau],[oas.shrinkage,oas.tau],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.models['oas_distance'][2],oas.transform(z),rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    ms=RobustScaler(quantile_range=(10,90)).fit(expected_multi)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.models['multirocket_distance'][0].center_,ms.center_,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.models['multirocket_distance'][0].scale_,ms.scale_,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    mz=ms.transform(expected_multi);moas=OASGeometry(mz)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.models['multirocket_distance'][1].center,moas.center,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.models['multirocket_distance'][2],moas.transform(mz),rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    joint=np.column_stack((expected_raw,expected_multi))
    js=RobustScaler(quantile_range=(10,90)).fit(joint)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.models['multirocket_joint'][0].center_,js.center_,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.models['multirocket_joint'][0].scale_,js.scale_,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    jz=js.transform(joint);joas=OASGeometry(jz)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(head.models['multirocket_joint'][2],joas.transform(jz),rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)

def _parity_and_isolation(fit,query):
    head=MultiRocketHeads(fit);scores=head.score(query)
    encoder=make_representation_antigravity('minirocket_local_gap',SEED)
    old=PairedHeads(encoder.fit_transform(fit)).score(encoder.transform(query))
    for name in ('MiniRocket','oas_distance'):np.testing.assert_allclose(scores[name],old[name],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    raw_fit=head.raw_encoder.transform(fit).copy();multi_fit=head.multi_encoder.transform(fit).copy()
    before={name:r.copy() for name,(_,_,r) in head.models.items()};single=head.score(query[:1]);head.score(np.concatenate((query,query)))
    for name in head.names:np.testing.assert_allclose(single[name],scores[name][:1],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    for name,(_,_,reference) in head.models.items():np.testing.assert_array_equal(before[name],reference)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(raw_fit,head.raw_encoder.transform(fit))
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(multi_fit,head.multi_encoder.transform(fit))
    return head,scores

def test_baseline_raw_oas_isolation_and_n2():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(505);x=rng.normal(size=(12,64));q=rng.normal(size=(5,64))
    for n in (2,12):
        head,scores=_parity_and_isolation(x[:n],q)
        assert head.names==('MiniRocket','oas_distance','multirocket_distance','multirocket_joint')
        assert set(scores)==set(head.names)
        assert all(v.shape==(len(q),) and np.isfinite(v).all() for v in scores.values())
        assert head.length==64
        assert head.diagnostics['raw_featuredim']+head.diagnostics['multi_featuredim']==head.models['multirocket_joint'][2].shape[1]
        assert head.models['multirocket_joint'][2].shape[0]==n
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):MultiRocketHeads(x).score(q[:,:-1])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):MultiRocketHeads(np.ones((1,64)))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):MultiRocketHeads(np.array([[1.,2.,3.],[np.nan,0.,1.]]))
    bad=q.copy();bad[0,-1]=np.inf
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):MultiRocketHeads(x).score(bad)

def test_short_length_constants_and_l9():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(505)
    for length in (1,2,9):
        fit=rng.normal(size=(8,length));query=rng.normal(size=(5,length))
        head,scores=_parity_and_isolation(fit,query)
        assert head.length==length
        assert head.diagnostics['raw_featuredim']>=1 and head.diagnostics['multi_featuredim']>=1
        assert head.models['multirocket_joint'][2].shape==(8,head.diagnostics['raw_featuredim']+head.diagnostics['multi_featuredim'])
        assert all(v.shape==(5,) and np.isfinite(v).all() for v in scores.values())
    scores=MultiRocketHeads(np.zeros((4,128))).score(np.zeros((3,128)))
    assert set(scores)==set(MultiRocketHeads.names) and all(v.shape==(3,) and np.isfinite(v).all() for v in scores.values())
    const=np.ones((5,16));const[0]=0
    out=MultiRocketHeads(const).score(np.full((2,16),-3.0))
    assert all(v.shape==(2,) and np.isfinite(v).all() for v in out.values())

"""Complete-head CPU acceleration assessment for Exp505 MultiRocket OAS geometry."""
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import configure_inner_threads_antigravity
configure_inner_threads_antigravity()
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter
import hashlib,importlib.metadata,json
import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import ROOT,file_sha256_antigravity,write_json_atomic_antigravity,cpu_worker_policy_antigravity
from experiments.exp505_multirocket_geometry_antigravity.multirocket_antigravity import MultiRocketHeads
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def _version(dist):
    try:return importlib.metadata.version(dist)
    except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:return None

def _digest(scores):
    return {k:hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(scores[k],dtype=np.float64).tobytes()).hexdigest() for k in MultiRocketHeads.names}

def _ranks(scores):
    return {k:np.argsort(np.asarray(scores[k],dtype=np.float64),kind='stable') for k in MultiRocketHeads.names}

def _run(fit,query):
    heads=MultiRocketHeads(fit);scores=heads.score(query);return heads,scores

def main():
    result=P/'acceleration_results_antigravity.json'
    policy=cpu_worker_policy_antigravity()
    inherited=ROOT/'experiments/exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity/acceleration_results_antigravity.json'
    rng=np.random.default_rng(505)
    fit=rng.normal(size=(64,128));fit[0]=0;query=rng.normal(size=(1024,128))
    with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
        t0=perf_counter();heads,first=_run(fit,query);first_seconds=perf_counter()-t0
        t0=perf_counter();_,warm=_run(fit,query);warm_seconds=perf_counter()-t0
        again=heads.score(query)
        left=heads.score(query[:512]);right=heads.score(query[512:])
        batched={k:np.concatenate((left[k],right[k])) for k in MultiRocketHeads.names}
    exact_repeated_fit=all(np.array_equal(first[k],warm[k]) for k in MultiRocketHeads.names)
    exact_rescore=all(np.array_equal(first[k],again[k]) for k in MultiRocketHeads.names)
    exact_batch_query=all(np.array_equal(first[k],batched[k]) for k in MultiRocketHeads.names)
    r1,r2=_ranks(first),_ranks(warm)
    exact_ranks=all(np.array_equal(r1[k],r2[k]) for k in MultiRocketHeads.names)
    out=dict(
        state='complete_acceleration_assessment',
        seed=505,fit_shape=[64,128],query_shape=[1024,128],constant_fit_rows=1,
        geometry_dtype='float64',
        candidates=list(MultiRocketHeads.names),
        first_seconds=first_seconds,warm_seconds=warm_seconds,
        exact_repeated_fit=bool(exact_repeated_fit),
        exact_rescore=bool(exact_rescore),
        exact_batch_query=bool(exact_batch_query),
        exact_ranks=bool(exact_ranks),
        score_sha256=_digest(first),
        diagnostics=heads.diagnostics,
        cpu_policy=policy,
        declared_cpu_policy=dict(workers=11,inner_threads=1),
        versions={n:_version(n) for n in ('aeon','numpy','scipy','scikit-learn','numba','torch','mlx','mlx-metal')},
        inherited_exp495_acceleration_results_sha256=file_sha256_antigravity(inherited),
        inherited_mlx_mps_float64_oas_unsupported_probe=True,
        mlx_mps_float64_oas_supported=False,
        numba_official_transform_rewrite=False,
        numba_mean3_nearest_rewrite=False,
        numba_speedup_claimed=False,
        torch_gpu_official_multirocket_api=False,
        concurrent_gpu_jobs_benchmarked=False,
        notes='Official MiniRocket and MultiRocket transforms are already Numba. OAS uses scipy cdist and LAPACK eigh on float64 CPU. A Numba mean-3-nearest reduction was not added: no reusable small exact function is available, EnergyHeads already uses np.sort on cdist, and rewriting official transforms would change the experiment. No Numba speedup is claimed. MLX/MPS float64 OAS is unsupported (inherited Exp495 probe). Torch GPU MultiRocket is unavailable via the public official Numba API. CPU policy is 11 workers with inner 1 thread; this file benchmarks one complete head fit+score path only.',
    )
    write_json_atomic_antigravity(result,out)
    print(json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ('first_seconds','warm_seconds','exact_repeated_fit','exact_batch_query','exact_ranks')}),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

Exp505 MultiRocket 기하

이 문서는 노출된 개발 벤치마크의 고정 프로토콜이며 홀드아웃이 아니다. 공식 평가 모집단은 데이터셋 1117개, 패밀리 128개다.

1차 목표

  • 경험적 거짓양성률 0.1% 이하.
  • MiniRocket 대비 패밀리 매크로 참양성률 상대 개선 10% 이상.
  • 거짓양성 0건 지점의 비회귀.

네 가지 예산과 세 가지 평균은 모두 보고한다. 모든 지표가 좋아져야 하는 것은 아니다.

동결

점수와 코드 해시는 TEST 라벨을 읽기 전에 고정한다. TEST로 후보를 고르지 않고, TEST에 맞춰 문턱이나 게이트를 바꾸지 않는다. TRAIN 비교는 인과 증거가 아니다.

파일럿 선택 규칙

Exp504와 같이 모집단 50개 패밀리, 5폴드, 적합 폴드만 사용하며 같은 오염과 시드를 쓴다. 정상 점수의 폴드 최댓값을 엄격한 문턱으로 둔다. 정상 꼬리 중앙값이 MiniRocket의 3배를 넘는 후보는 제외한다. 남은 후보에서 최악 오염 평균 재현율, 그다음 평균, 그다음 앞선 이름으로 고른다. 신규 헤드의 최악 오염 재현율이 MiniRocket과 oas_distance 중 더 나은 쪽보다 0.02 이상 높고 평균 재현율도 그 앵커 이상이어야 한다. 그렇지 않으면 앵커를 고른다.

알고리즘

헤드 순서는 MiniRocket, oas_distance, multirocket_distance, multirocket_joint이다. 입력은 이미 고정된 전역 행 z-정규화를 거친다. 같은 정상 적합 행에 공식 MiniRocket(요청 n_kernels=4096, 실제 4032, n_jobs=1, seed 20260721)과 공식 MultiRocket(n_kernels=1024, n_features_per_kernel=4, n_jobs=1, normalise=False, seed 20260721)을 적합한다. 표현을 재구현하거나 파라미터를 바꾸거나 특성을 자르거나 가중치를 두거나 뷰를 정규화하지 않는다. 길이가 9 미만이면 기존 래퍼가 0으로 패딩하며 길이별 폴백은 없다.

기준 점수는 원본 MiniRocket 특성의 LocalGap이다. 원본, MultiRocket, 둘의 이어붙임 각각에 RobustScaler 분위수 10–90과 잔차 보존 OAS를 적합하고, 질의-참조 유클리드 거리의 최근접 min(3, n) 평균을 쓴다. 원본 OAS 스케일러는 LocalGap 스케일러와 같다. 참조 상한 1000과 그 시드는 이후 fullrunner에서만 적용한다.

TRAIN-only numbers show energy joint cleared the frozen +0.02 gate while quarter-MiniRocket and QUANT joints did not; that does not establish that MultiRocket extra pools or raw/diff channels cause a lift, nor that OAS will handle their heterogeneous, possibly zero-IQR coordinates. The design reuses official MultiRocket (1024/4/n_jobs=1/normalise=False/seed 20260721) and existing residual OAS without retuning the gate or TEST. Limits: MIPV -1 sentinels and mixed PPV/MPV/LSPV scales; joint concatenates MiniRocket PPV with MultiRocket that already includes PPV-like features; n=2 / p~10^4 OAS is inherited and numerically stressed; official transform calls nan_to_num; QUANT already failed the same selection rule.
